title: Verify: Store focus focuses the matching scene object unit tests
summary: Phaser-mocked tests for applying store focus
description: TDD unit tests proving that setting focusedObjectId focuses and labels the matching object through SceneObject.focus().
acceptance_criteria: Setting focusedObjectId to an object id calls focus() on it
A different focused object is blurred
technical_constraints: Mock phaser, ../src/runtime/content, @game/engine/buildScene, buildEffects, playSceneTransition, renderContext and effectContext exactly as in game/frontend/tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts

steps.action: Create the file copying the vi.mock block and beforeEach from bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts. Build two fake objects {id:'bookshelf'} and {id:'bed'} with sync, destroy, onInteract, handleKey, focus, blur vi.fn() and a mutable isFocused, spec.id. buildScene mockReturnValue returns both; call boot.create().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusApply.test.ts

steps.action: Call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject('bookshelf'); assert bookshelf.focus called once and bed.focus not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusApply.test.ts -t 'focuses the object matching'

steps.symbol: it('blurs a previously focused object and ignores unknown ids')
steps.action: Set bed.isFocused = true, call setFocusedObject('bookshelf'); assert bed.blur called. Then setFocusedObject('missing'); assert no further focus() calls and no throw.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusApply.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass
